findings.title: Two-piece seat cannot serve as a fallback because its purge gap is not described
findings.attack: An amendment to the rigid seat and wiper ring must state that the wiper ring's deflection opens the purge gap; the description says only that it deflects outward and wipes. The amendment would be refused as not directly and unambiguously disclosed.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add the purge gap 146 to the two-piece seat paragraphs and Statement 7.1: boundaries, closed state at rest, relation to the main passage, path of the air purge.

findings.title: Fit band and free portion disclosed only with the relief, and tested construction not identified
findings.attack: The fit band, free portion and relief are introduced together; a claim to the first two against a plain bore is an intermediate generalisation, and [0202] disclaims the relief for the tested valve cores without saying what they had.
findings.least_narrowing_action: State whether the fit band and free portion are used with a plain core body bore, and state the construction of the tested valve cores.

findings.title: Wall-slot and valve-stem-bore arrangements too thinly described to carry an amendment
findings.attack: The wall slots are placed in a free portion and also combined with a fully retained outer surface. The valve-stem-bore arrangement is one sentence without a figure, and claim 47 excludes claim 45.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Describe the two wall-slot arrangements separately; add a figure and paragraph for the valve-stem-bore arrangement and extend claim 47 to claim 45.

findings.title: Parameters with a single value give no room to amend
findings.attack: The normal stroke, interference fit, composition, shape-setting conditions and austenite finish temperature each have one value or one bound; no relation between parameters is stated.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Ask the inventor for workable ranges, the method of determining the austenite finish temperature and any relation between dimensions; add them as candidates.

findings.title: Disclosed alternatives lie outside every claim, one by the description's own statement
findings.attack: [0179] describes a disc spring that opens a purge gap and says its deflection is not a radial expansion, which tells a competitor how to avoid claim 1. The detent and spring-loaded stop are outside claim 6. Unclaimed disclosed subject matter is dedicated to the public in the United States.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add a generic claim to a deflectable element whose deflection opens the purge gap, with claim-support statements and a figure, and a generic term for the threshold-separating return arrangement. Nothing is given up.

findings.title: Combination clause is closed
findings.attack: Features may be combined only in the combinations set out under Combinations, and [0217] lists six forms that exclude the slotted sleeve, split seat ring, tapered seat ring, collar, detent and wall slots.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Replace with an open statement and extend [0217] to every form of the radially deflectable element, load-applying surface and return bias.

assumptions.text: A1. The rejection premise is built from the saved references only.
A2. Claims as filed count as part of the application as filed for basis at the EPO and UK IPO.
A3. The drawings will follow the figure instructions.
A4. AI drafting and analysis aid; qualified patent counsel signs off before filing.

open_questions.text: Q1. What ranges are believed workable for the normal stroke, the interference fit and the shape-setting conditions?
Q2. How was the austenite finish temperature of the prototype seat rings determined?
Q3. Were the disc-spring element, the detent and the spring-loaded stop conceived by the inventor, and are they to be claimed?
Q4. For counsel: is the thermal variant to be kept, given that it contradicts the definition in [0065]?
